subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should the three optional GetReplyOptions progress-lifecycle fields become the canonical public Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned progress presentation?
rationale: The implementation and compatibility checks are strong, but an additive Plugin SDK surface is a lasting external contract whose ownership and naming cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Accept the channel-owned seam
options.body: Keep the three optional fields as the canonical contract, fix the Discord final-start race, rebase, and rerun exact-head proof.

options.title: Narrow the public API
options.body: Replace the three callbacks with a smaller lifecycle abstraction or keep some state internal before exposing the contract.

options.title: Split gate fix from headline feature
options.body: Land the time-gate and cancellation repair separately while the preamble-headline SDK design remains under discussion.

recommendation.title: Accept the channel-owned seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three optional fields as the canonical contract, fix the Discord final-start race, rebase, and rerun exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership metadata and the feature history make this person the clearest available owner for the permanent SDK-boundary decision.
